description: Use this when a user asks how pump prices have changed over recent days or weeks in a place, or whether fuel is getting cheaper. Returns the daily median and typical range of pump prices in the area, with the change over the period, from our daily snapshots of official data. Do not use for today's cheapest stations. After 10 free calls a day per caller this tool costs USD 0.02 per answered call, paid with x402 (USDC); a 402 reply lists how. Nothing is charged for "not enough records" or errors.

area.description: Wider area when no postcode. AU (Queensland only): 'Brisbane' (postcodes 4000 to 4179) or 'QLD' (the whole state). A suburb name also works. AU (Western Australia only): 'Perth' (the Metro region), 'WA' (the whole state), a FuelWatch…

country.description: AU = Australia, Queensland only (monthly station prices reported to the Queensland Government); AU = Australia, Western Australia only (FuelWatch daily station prices); BR = Brazil (ANP weekly survey: regular petrol and diesel S10); CA = Canada (Ontario…

days.description: How many recent days to include. Default 30.

fuel.description: petrol95 = unleaded 95; methane = CNG (priced per kg). Queensland: diesel, petrol95 (= standard Unleaded, 91 RON), petrol98, e10, e85 or lpg. Western Australia: diesel, petrol95 (= standard unleaded ULP, 91 RON), petrol98, lpg or e85…

gasoline_grade.description: US only: the gasoline grade EIA publishes. Overrides the grade implied by fuel (petrol95 = regular, petrol98 = premium); use midgrade here with fuel=petrol95. Not for diesel.

months.description: Instead of days: how many whole months of monthly history to return, where a source has loaded long history.

postcode.description: Postcode of the place. AU (Queensland only): 4-digit postcode starting with 4, e.g. '4122'. Most single postcodes have fewer than 5 stations of one fuel; use area 'Brisbane' or 'QLD' then. AU (Western Australia only): 4-digit postcode…

service.description: Self-service or attended service, where a country prices them differently. Ontario: not used (the survey does not split self and full service). Canada: self only. Full-service prices stopped in 2013. CO: not used. Costa Rica: not used. EU…
